reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I actually have a reason, and the named lab with a batch report I can check is the first supplement pitch that answers my doubts. At the launch price of $24.99 and with the empty-box guarantee, one box is a low-risk try.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I don't know if my level is truly low, and I'd want to be sure this is the right dose for me.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor told me not to take magnesium, or if the lab report on the product page turned out not to match the batch number on the box.
